positions.name: Advanced Micro Devices
positions.catalyst: Report that AMD notified customers of a ~10% chip price hike starting Q4 (TSMC cost pass-through, AI compute demand) — pricing-power/margin catalyst; stock +2.2% premarket (642.94 ask vs 629.26 close), extending a 3-session run. Nasdaq futures +0.4–0.6%, semis bid (SMH +1.2%, MU +1.2%), oil -2.3% on US–Iran/Hormuz talk progress.
positions.driver: Stock-specific margin catalyst is less rate-dependent than a broad-index bet while the 10y sits at a 17-year high (5.19%). Not chasing: +2.2% vs >8% bar. 1x not 2x (AMDL +4%) because the price-hike report is unverified and yields are still rising into Friday data. Runners-up: AMDL (2x same thesis, too much gap risk on unverified report), SOXL (3x semis +4.1% pre — broad chase into yields), TSLA/TSLL (Roadster tease is Oct 1, weak near-term catalyst), SCO (oil -2.3% already moved), BTC spot (flat, 190bp spread).
positions.risks: AMD denies/walks back the price-hike report; yields extend above 5.2% on a hot inflation print and hit long-duration tech; semis give back premarket gap. Hard stop 604.36 (-6%).
